sources.label: Government of Newfoundland and Labrador Final Value-for-Money Assessment
sources.note: The direct final government assessment identifies one Project Agreement signed on 2019-06-14 and one ProjectCo, Fengate Central Health, LP, covering both care homes. It states that funds managed by Fengate Capital Management Ltd. provide project risk capital and separately identifies Pomerleau Inc. as design-builder. Its structure diagram identifies Fengate Capital Management Ltd. as equity and service provider, Pomerleau Inc. as design and construction, and TD Securities as debt underwriter. It does not disclose any limited-partner, beneficial-owner or percentage schedule and therefore does not prove SEC Pomerleau equity or a cutoff-current cap table. The PDF text layer was extracted successfully; selected pages were rendered, although non-embedded font glyphs rendered poorly outside the legible structure diagram.

sources.label: Fengate Financial-Close Release
sources.note: The direct manager release confirms financial close for one Gander and Grand Falls-Windsor Care Homes project and the two-home scope. It does not name a Fengate fund, legal ProjectCo limited partners, percentages or a later ownership transfer.

sources.label: Current Government Central Long-Term Care Project Page
sources.status: OPEN_AND_TEXT_VERIFIED; OWNERSHIP ROLE METADATA CONFLICTS WITH FINAL ASSESSMENT
sources.note: The current provincial page describes one DBFM procurement for two 60-bed facilities, records opening in May 2022, and labels Fengate Capital Management Ltd. and SEC Pomerleau as equity providers. It does not disclose a legal subscription, ProjectCo holder, percentage, effective date or transfer, so the SEC Pomerleau label cannot override the post-close final assessment or establish current ownership.

sources.label: Government Shortlisted Team Compositions
sources.note: The direct procurement-stage table labels Fengate Capital Management Ltd. and SEC Pomerleau as respondent team leads/equity providers and Pomerleau as design-builder. It is a shortlisted-team document, not an executed ProjectCo register, subscription schedule or current cap table.

sources.label: Pomerleau Project Page
sources.note: The constructor page treats the two facilities as one project and presents Pomerleau as builder while identifying Fengate as developer. It supplies no direct ProjectCo equity, LP, percentage or transfer evidence for SEC Pomerleau or Pomerleau Inc.

sources.label: Companies and Deeds Online Registry Scope
sources.note: The official registry page says the Registry maintains public information on corporations and limited partnerships, defines limited partners as investors or promoters, and explicitly says the Registry does not maintain corporate shareholder lists. The page does not itself identify Fengate Central Health, LP's partners.

sources.label: Fengate Central Health GP Inc. Aggregator Index
sources.note: The returned secondary index could not be independently read because its current response was an access-denied page. Its company-name, number and status claim was independently checked against the official CADO result and detail pages below; the aggregator is not used as application evidence.

sources.label: Official CADO Search Result and Company Detail for Fengate Central Health GP Inc.
sources.note: A direct official name search returned Fengate Central Health GP Inc., company number 84100, status Active, type Company, with 2019-06-05 displayed. The detail page identifies an active extra-provincial company incorporated in Manitoba on 2019-05-02 and registered in Newfoundland and Labrador on 2019-06-05. Neither result links the corporation to Fengate Central Health, LP, identifies its shareholders or proves that it is the ProjectCo general partner.

sourceSetAssessment.primaryLabel: Government of Newfoundland and Labrador Final Value-for-Money Assessment
sourceSetAssessment.reason: It is the direct post-close government assessment that defines the single ProjectCo and two-facility agreement, separates equity, debt and design-build roles, and exposes rather than fills the missing LP and percentage schedule.
sourceSetAssessment.gap: No direct current ProjectCo partnership register, executed LP schedule, shareholder or beneficial-owner record, fund report, financing ownership schedule, change-of-control approval or sponsor disclosure identifies the complete current 100% Fengate Central Health, LP ownership chain or proves whether SEC Pomerleau subscribed, retained, transferred or never held ProjectCo equity.

conclusion: Fresh direct evidence continues to establish one Gander and Grand Falls-Windsor Care Homes Project, one ProjectCo and one Project Agreement covering both facilities. The standalone Grand Falls-Windsor source task can therefore be superseded into the existing canonical project without any database or seed ownership change. The same evidence does not establish the current ProjectCo cap table, exact Fengate fund or vehicle, limited partners, beneficial owners, percentages, or SEC Pomerleau's close-date or current equity status. Preserve that exact exception on the canonical record and do not infer ownership from procurement-team labels, manager continuity, construction roles, registry-name similarity or absence of an announced exit.
